title: Caspian Blue Paradise | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set within the coveted Magnolia Cottages by the Sea community, Caspian Blue Paradise is a luxurious coastal haven designed to bring large families and groups together in style. The five-bedroom main cottage, paired with a charming one-bedroom carriage house, offers refined comfort and space for up to twenty-three guests. Crisp, elegant interiors are matched with thoughtful touches throughout, while the included golf cart and complimentary bikes make beach access and local exploring effortless. Our vacation rental properties may not be accessible to all types of vehicles. Guests are responsible for ensuring their mode of transportation can safely access the property. The rental company is not responsible if a guest's vehicle is unable to reach the home due to the property's terrain, driveway, or other access limitations. Guests should review all property details and communicate any concerns about vehicle access prior to booking.
